newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura falls in heavy trade after arrest.
newsitem.headline: Nomura falls in heavy trade after arrest.

text.p: Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd slipped in heavy trade on Monday morning following the arrest of a former president of the company on Friday in connection with a scandal involving illegal payoffs to a racketeer, traders said.
At 0017 GMT, Nomura was down 40 yen at 1,340. Turnover was 2.391 million shares, making it the most actively traded issue.
"The pay-off scandal continued to depress investors," said a trader at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
On Friday, the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said it would deal "in a strict manner" with the case of Nomura, depending on the outcome of investigations into the scandal.
